lines.say: In 1970, Oregon tried to blow up a fucking whale.
Forty-five feet long, eight tons, rotting on the beach.
The highway department was in charge, and their answer was half a ton of dynamite.
The plan was that the pieces would fly out toward the ocean.
Instead, people a quarter mile back were running while rotten whale rained out of the sky.
One giant chunk crushed a brand new Cadillac.
And the dealership that sold it? Their slogan was, a whale of a deal. No shit.
